mathematical_meanings: Left image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right tip of the horizontal axis beside the descending line). Right image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right end of the horizontal axis passing through a circle).
Rationales: In both images, x names the horizontal coordinate axis. The relevant locations are the right tip of the horizontal axis beside the descending line on the left and the right end of the horizontal axis passing through a circle on the right.
